test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : TRV :: SQU : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Given: # : TRV :: SQU : %

Option 1) # = IOY, % = PWR → IOY : TRV :: SQU : PWR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68c276850fdd6db07b3414e106f57d1d43e4712f1311f1c4856493498a200637.png] 

Option 2) # = WUO, % = ZNR → WUO : TRV :: SQU : ZNR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab4bb346a243a26bf3f4e65901650c52f792fd7f51e5927e10579e88cf7caa6f.png] 

Option 3) # = WUY, % = PNR → WUY : TRV :: SQU : PNR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3317ec2347d39101ac6aeebe02cbadb4d0aab90eb768cb56d7080125bef6bccb.png] 

Option 4) # = WZY, % = UQR → WZY : TRV :: SQU : UQR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/338ec780d0e507095200d1751d8a31330159bff41710240d6c408bcc6a64d565.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'MS – PL' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
